honest_scope_stated_now.what_is_measured: recall of the gold node SET at matched exposure -- whether the partition machinery puts the right nodes in front of L2 better than a flat list of the same size
honest_scope_stated_now.compute_not_measured: the flat arms score every node exhaustively (dense and SPLADE over all N); the routes use two top-100 lists, the STRUCT memberships and the block structure.  No latency or cost claim either way.
honest_scope_stated_now.downstream_not_measured: the blocks' other roles -- L2 locality features, L3 traversal seeds, scoping speed -- are not measured; a flat win here does not by itself remove partitions from the system
honest_scope_stated_now.coverage: three datasets (MetaQA KB, SQuAD, MuSiQue) on five caches, DEV_A split A only; no 2Wiki / HotpotQA / WebQSP; no DEV_B, no TEST
honest_scope_stated_now.exhaustive_vs_served: the flat rankings are exhaustive recomputations from the stored vectors (the served caches keep a top-1000 only, too shallow for a ~5,000-node budget); agreement with the served lists is measured and gated (dry runs below)
honest_scope_stated_now.ALL_gold: multi-gold queries need every gold node; the flat list has no notion of a bridge, the routes carry graph votes -- that difference is the thing being measured
